snippet.title: Trees Hate You Release Date Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4171850/Trees_Hate_You/

Trees Hate You is an unpredictable rage game where you avoid all manner of pesky flora, and a new trailer aired during the Future Games Show at gamescom, revealing it will launch on November 16 later this year.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
